consequence.statement: Error messages for compose functions are more detailed when the composite resource has an issue; no operational consequence is stated.

original.statement: Compose function error messages are expanded when an issue with the composite resource is detected; no operational impact stated.

decision.reason: [ev-3c60f5b1516b] only says that compose function error messages now give more detail when there is an issue with the composite resource. It does not say anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. More detailed diagnostics need no operator action, so "none" (informational) fits better than behavior-change. Nothing in the evidence points to a review-worthy change in how things work.
